market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: At current silver prices (~$32/oz), reaching $120 requires a ~3.75x rally in a year and a half, far beyond any historical analog or fundamental catalyst. Even the 1979-80 mania peaked at $49.45, so $120 settlement is an extreme outlier with near-zero probability.
evidence_points: Silver’s all-time nominal high is ~$49.45 (1980); CPI-adjusted high is ~$150, but settlement-based $120 would require far higher real price under current CPI.
Current CME SI futures active month settlement price (early 2025) is around $32, implying a >270% gain needed by June 2026.
CME settlement methodology ignores intraday spikes and only records official end-of-day settlement, lowering the chance of capturing a fleeting high.
sources_consulted: CME Group Silver Futures (SI) daily settlement data (historical)
